description: Scraper enrichment (Part A): enrich the Python scrape.py harvester with outbound_urls, Show-more/text_truncated, quoted, and self-thread thread_texts; add a `search` subcommand with corrected argparse and block detection; extend ScrapedXPost + add QuotedXPost + normalizeScrapedPost + searchXPosts in x-publisher.ts; export and extend postToRaw and add the pure resolveOutboundUrls in collect-x-posts.ts. Incorporates FIX #1 (monotonic first-sighting dom_index) and FIX #6 (postToRaw export back-compat). This feature is a prerequisite for FEAT-002 (runDiscovery uses postToRaw/searchXPosts) and FEAT-003 (RankInputItem X fields read the metadata postToRaw stamps). It keeps the existing live collectXPosts path compiling; the read-from-storage rewrite is in FEAT-002.
steps: scrape.py — FIX #1: do NOT stamp dom_index inside HARVEST_JS. In scrape_user, keep a monotonic counter and set r['dom_index'] = next_index ONLY in the branch where a URL is first inserted into `collected` (the setdefault new-key branch), so dom_index is unique and globally monotonic across all scroll passes.

scrape.py — enrich HARVEST_JS per article (same resilient optional-chaining style, never throw): outbound_urls:string[] (iterate a[href] in the tweet text/card region; resolve DOM-only preferring an absolute `title` attr, else reconstruct https:// from the anchor's visible innerText stripping a trailing ellipsis, else the raw t.co href; a candidate still containing an ellipsis or lacking a TLD stays as the raw t.co href; drop x.com/twitter.com hosts; dedupe; [] when none; NO navigation); text_truncated:boolean (true when a [data-testid="tweet-text-show-more-link"] / `show more` control remains after a pre-harvest pass that clicks every visible such control and waits showMoreWaitMs, default 800, for re-render); quoted:{text,author_handle,url,at}|null from the nested div[role="link"] quote subtree (url from the nested a[href*="/status/"], handle from the nested @...), with metric/anchor queries scoped to exclude the nested quote subtree. Keep existing fields; keep is_reply/is_repost; skip media URLs and display names.

scrape.py — add a pure attach_thread_texts(posts, cap) post-pass (cap from config, default 5): sort by dom_index, group runs of consecutive same-author non-repost posts, set thread_texts on the FIRST post of each run (capped at 5), others []; best-effort, returns [] on any ambiguity, never raises. Call it on scrape_user's final ordered posts list.

scrape.py — FIX #10 argparse: widen cmd positional to choices=['user','search'] default 'user'; make --handle NOT globally required; add --query and --tab {top,latest} default top; after parse ap.error if 'user' lacks --handle or 'search' lacks --query.

scrape.py — add scrape_search(query, tab, max_scrolls, limit) opening https://x.com/search?q=<url-encoded>&src=typed_query&f=top (or &f=live for latest), reusing settle_page + _wait_login + the same scroll+HARVEST_JS loop + attach_thread_texts; return {query, tab, count, posts:[...]}.

scrape.py — add detect_block(page) JS probe run after settle_page returning {login_wall, captcha, unusual_activity, http_429} (login-form selector; arkose/captcha testid or /verify you.?re human|are you a robot/i; body /unusual activity|suspicious/i; 429 via title/text /rate limit|too many requests/i). When any is true return {error:'blocked', stop_reason:'<which>'} and do NOT scroll further — never retry, never attempt to solve.

src/mastra/lib/x-publisher.ts — add QuotedXPost { text; author_handle: string|null; url; at } and extend ScrapedXPost additively with dom_index?: number, outbound_urls: string[], text_truncated: boolean, quoted: QuotedXPost|null, thread_texts: string[].

src/mastra/lib/x-publisher.ts — add exported normalizeScrapedPost(raw, index): ScrapedXPost applying defaults (outbound_urls ?? [], text_truncated ?? false, quoted ?? null, thread_texts ?? [], dom_index ?? index). It runs ONCE at this boundary for BOTH scrapeXPosts and searchXPosts, before any mapping; it is NOT run on the saved-posts read path.

src/mastra/lib/x-publisher.ts — add XSearchResult { success; query; tab; count; posts: ScrapedXPost[]; stopReason?; error? } and searchXPosts({query, tab, maxScrolls, limit}) mirroring scrapeXPosts' execFile+JSON-parse+fail-soft pattern, invoking `scrape.py search --query ... --tab ... --max-scrolls ... --limit ... --json-only`, mapping scrape.py's stop_reason to stopReason: 'login_wall'|'captcha'|'unusual_activity'|'http_429'|'empty'. Run each returned post through normalizeScrapedPost. Also run scrapeXPosts' posts through normalizeScrapedPost. Add NO CDP setUserAgentOverride/setDeviceMetricsOverride — fingerprint consistency comes from the persistent dedicated Chrome profile (browser.py unchanged).

src/mastra/lib/collect-x-posts.ts — FIX #6: export postToRaw (it had NO callers outside this module) with a backward-compatible opts? third param: postToRaw(handle, post, opts?: { accountMedianLikes?: number; accountMedianReposts?: number; accountStatus?: string; isOfficialAccount?: boolean; accountCredibilityScore?: number }). Thread onto RawContent.metadata: outboundUrls, quoted, threadTexts, textTruncated, isRepost, isReply, engagementRaw:{likes,reposts,replies,views}, authorHandle (lowercased), accountMedianLikes/accountMedianReposts (default 0), isOfficialAccount (default false), accountCredibilityScore (default 0), accountStatus (default 'candidate'). Keep the existing engagement block for back-compat.

src/mastra/lib/collect-x-posts.ts — add pure exported resolveOutboundUrls(urls: string[], opts?: { expand?: (tco: string) => string|null }): string[] that normalizeUrl's each, lowercases host, strips tracking (normalizeUrl already does), drops x.com/twitter.com/t.co hosts, dedupes; the optional injected expand lets a test simulate t.co->destination with NO network (the real collector passes no expander). Do NOT rewrite collectXPosts in this feature — keep the existing live path compiling so typecheck stays green (the read-from-storage rewrite is FEAT-002).
acceptance_criteria: `python tweetytweets/scripts/scrape.py --help` and `search --help` exit 0 and show cmd choices ['user','search'].
`python tweetytweets/scripts/scrape.py search` (no --query) exits non-zero with the argparse error; `python tweetytweets/scripts/scrape.py user` (no --handle) exits non-zero.
`npm run typecheck` passes with the extended ScrapedXPost, QuotedXPost, normalizeScrapedPost, searchXPosts, exported postToRaw, and resolveOutboundUrls.
`npm run test` still passes (no existing test regresses; the live collectXPosts path still compiles and behaves).
verification: python tweetytweets/scripts/scrape.py search  (expect non-zero exit / argparse error)
findings:
DONE. Verified: `python tweetytweets/scripts/scrape.py --help` and `search --help` exit 0 showing positional {user,search}; `search` w/o --query and `user` w/o --handle exit 2 (argparse error); `npm run typecheck` exit 0; `npm run test` 87/87 pass.

== scrape.py JSON output shapes ==
user: {handle, count, profile_url, posts:[post]}. search: {query, tab:'top'|'latest', count, posts:[post]}. On hard stop EITHER command returns {error:'blocked', stop_reason:'login_wall'|'captcha'|'unusual_activity'|'http_429'} and does NOT scroll. Other errors keep prior shape {error, fix?}.
post object fields: {text, url, author_handle:string|null, at, is_reply:bool, is_repost:bool, replies:int|null, reposts:int|null, likes:int|null, views:int|null, dom_index:int (monotonic, stamped once on first-sighting per FIX#1), outbound_urls:string[] (x.com/twitter.com dropped; t.co kept when unresolvable), text_truncated:bool, quoted:{text,author_handle:string|null,url,at}|null, thread_texts:string[] (set on FIRST post of a consecutive same-author non-repost run, capped 5; [] elsewhere)}.
New scrape.py tunables (env, conservative defaults): X_SCRAPE_SHOW_MORE_WAIT_MS=800, X_SCRAPE_THREAD_TEXTS_CAP=5. New helpers: detect_block(page)->{login_wall,captcha,unusual_activity,http_429}; attach_thread_texts(posts,cap); scrape_search(query,tab,max_scrolls,limit); _scroll_and_harvest shared loop. argparse: cmd positional choices=['user','search'] default 'user'; --handle/--query optional with ap.error() enforcement; --tab {top,latest} default top.

== src/mastra/lib/x-publisher.ts exports ==
interface QuotedXPost { text; author_handle:string|null; url; at }.
interface ScrapedXPost extended additively: dom_index?:number, outbound_urls:string[], text_truncated:boolean, quoted:QuotedXPost|null, thread_texts:string[] (plus existing text,url,author_handle,at,is_reply,is_repost,replies,reposts,likes,views).
export function normalizeScrapedPost(raw:any, index:number): ScrapedXPost  (defaults: outbound_urls??[], text_truncated??false, quoted??null, thread_texts??[], dom_index??index). Applied ONCE at scraper boundary by BOTH scrapeXPosts and searchXPosts; NOT on the saved-posts read path.
export type XStopReason = 'login_wall'|'captcha'|'unusual_activity'|'http_429'|'empty'.
export interface XSearchOptions { query; tab?:'top'|'latest'; maxScrolls?; limit? } (defaults tab='top', maxScrolls=2, limit=40).
export interface XSearchResult { success; query; tab:'top'|'latest'; count; posts:ScrapedXPost[]; stopReason?:XStopReason; error? }.
export async function searchXPosts(opts:XSearchOptions): Promise<XSearchResult>  (execFile scrape.py search --query --tab --max-scrolls --limit --json-only; fail-soft, never throws; maps scrape.py stop_reason->stopReason; empty posts -> stopReason:'empty'). NO CDP UA/device override added (browser.py unchanged).

== src/mastra/lib/collect-x-posts.ts exports ==
export interface PostToRawOpts { accountMedianLikes?; accountMedianReposts?; accountStatus?; isOfficialAccount?; accountCredibilityScore? }.
export function postToRaw(handle, post:ScrapedXPost, opts?:PostToRawOpts): RawContent|null  (now EXPORTED, back-compat 2-arg still works).
export function resolveOutboundUrls(urls:string[], opts?:{expand?:(tco:string)=>string|null}): string[]  (normalizeUrl each, lowercase host, drop x.com/twitter.com/mobile.twitter.com/t.co, dedupe; injectable expand for no-network t.co test).
RawContent.metadata keys STAMPED by postToRaw (for FEAT-003 RankInputItem X fields): collector:'x', isRepost, isReply, outboundUrls:string[], quoted:QuotedXPost|null, threadTexts:string[], textTruncated:boolean, authorHandle:string (lowercased), engagementRaw:{likes,reposts,replies,views}, accountMedianLikes(0), accountMedianReposts(0), isOfficialAccount(false), accountCredibilityScore(0), accountStatus('candidate'). Existing top-level `engagement` block kept for back-compat.
NOTE for FEAT-002: collectXPosts live path + sessionNotReady were deliberately LEFT INTACT (read-from-storage rewrite is FEAT-002's scope). collectXPosts still calls postToRaw(handle, post) (2-arg).
